subject: Re: Executive clemency request — evaluation top-up + term stretch for Synthesis AI
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@synthesis.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Eval extension & top-up request

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the fast turnaround on the demo last week. We kicked off the POC on Monday and the team has already consumed roughly 80% of the PLG credits due to larger-than-expected end-to-end tests (multi-tenant inference + long transcript embeddings). Procurement is still working on the PO but has asked for a short confirmation that Redwood will continue the environment while they finalize paperwork.

Two asks from our side:
- One-time credit top-up: $15,000 in additional credits to finish the integration tests and load testing.
- Term stretch: extension of the POC window by 45 days (current PLG window is 30 days). Procurement expects to have a PO signed within ~2–3 weeks but they need assurance we won’t pull the environment.

We’re prepared to sign a short MOU confirming the scope and to provide a procurement contact (procurement@synthesis.ai) for the PO. Can you let us know what’s required for exec-level approval? We’re excited about the fit — this could be a multi-year platform deal if the next phase goes well.

Attachments: SynthesisAI-POC-Plan.pdf, Synthesis-Procurement-note.docx

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Head of Engineering
Synthesis AI
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@synthesis.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval extension & top-up request

Hi Ellen —

Appreciate the context and congrats on the quick progress. I’ve looped in Marissa (AE) and Jonas + Aditya from Revenue to evaluate for a one-off exception. Two quick clarifying items that will speed an answer:
1) Can procurement provide a tentative PO date or a short MOU this week? That helps us make the credit contingent on a procurement milestone.
2) Are there any additional compliance requirements (e.g., isolated VPC, data residency) that would change cost expectations beyond token usage?

Next steps: I’ll escalate to execs for clemency. If you can confirm the PO timeline, I’ll propose a conditional approval (credits released after MOU/PO milestone).

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@synthesis.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec clemency request — evaluation top-up + term stretch for Synthesis AI

Ellen / team —

Thanks for the clear ask and the POC plan. I’m prepared to approve a one-time exception with the following conditions:

- Credit grant: $12,000 in consumable Redwood credits, issued as a one-off top-up.
- Term extension: 45-day extension from the current expiration date.
- Contingency: credits will be unlocked once Synthesis executes either (a) a signed MOU outlining scope and PO timeline, or (b) a valid procurement PO in progress (procurement acknowledgement email acceptable for the unlock).
- Legal/sales: Marissa, please prepare a short addendum (SOW MOU) for Ellen to sign; Legal should keep standard terms but include the unlock condition.

I’m authorizing this as a one-off executive concession — this is not precedent setting; please record the decision in HubSpot and attach the approved-exception-memo for auditing.

Jonas Weber
SVP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

-----Forwarded attachment: approved-exception-memo.pdf (memo, 1 page)
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@synthesis.ai>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, procurement@synthesis.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec clemency request — evaluation top-up + term stretch for Synthesis AI

Jonas / Karthik / Marissa —

This is great, thank you. We accept the conditions. Procurement will route a preliminary PO acknowledgement to Marissa by next Wednesday (2026-04-22) and we’ll sign the short MOU this week to make the unlock explicit.

Marissa — please send the addendum and I’ll have our legal and procurement review it immediately.

Thanks for the quick help — looking forward to continuing the POC.

Best,
Ellen
Head of Engineering, Synthesis AI

Attachments received: SynthesisAI-POC-Plan.pdf
